guards.what: the sim short-circuits the page flow once the player is dead

guards.what: EV-1 (second verb): Decipher's kill branch (TabletOfTruth.cs:106) via events/tablet_of_truth.py:68 calls RunState.kill (run.py:304-305), which sets hp = 0. C#'s CreatureCmd.Kill(creature, force: false) runs Hook.BeforeDeath and then Hook.ShouldDie / Hook.AfterPreventingDeath before the creature actually dies (CreatureCmd.cs:439-448, 489-507), over RunState.IterateHookListeners, which yields the potion belt outside combat (RunState.cs:545-596)
guards.issue: MECHANISM EV-1, one verdict at every site (rule 3). Recorded at the damage verb as 'RunState.lose_hp'; this is the SAME missing run-level death-prevention pass reached through the second verb, so it takes EV-1's verdict rather than a new one, and EV-1's radius widens from 18 lose_hp sites to those plus run.kill. Note the `force` argument exists precisely to BYPASS the pass ('true in certain built-in cases like abandoning a run', CreatureCmd.cs:436) and the event passes force: false. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes.py kill`): a 20/20 run holding a belt Fairy in a Bottle that deciphers three times (costs 3, 6, then 12 against a max of 11, taking the kill branch) ends at max_hp/hp = 1/0 and DEAD with the Fairy still in the belt; the game's ShouldDie pass has the Fairy answer and heal to max(MaxHp*0.3, 1) = 1, leaving the player alive at 1/1 with the Fairy consumed. LIVE -- Fairy in a Bottle is ported (potions.py:1222-1250) and in the reward pool (potion_pools.py:49), and the divergence ends the run.

guards.what: EV-2: every Decipher's max-HP loss (TabletOfTruth.cs:105, 109) via events/tablet_of_truth.py:67, 70 calls RunState.lose_max_hp (run.py:316-321), which floors max HP and CLAMPS current HP. C#'s CreatureCmd.LoseMaxHp (CreatureCmd.cs) damages the overflow through the damage pipeline (Unblockable|Unpowered) FIRST, against the UNFLOORED new max, and only then calls SetMaxHp(Math.Max(1m, newMaxHp))
guards.issue: MECHANISM EV-2, one verdict at every lose_max_hp site (rule 3). Two legs, both EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/event_probes.py maxhp`): (1) the overflow is real damage, so HP-loss modifiers apply -- at 80/80 losing 10 max HP with the ported Tungsten Rod relic the sim lands on 70 and the game on 71; (2) losing more max HP than the player has: the game computes the damage against the unfloored new max (80 - 100 = -20, so 100 damage) and kills the player, while the sim floors max HP at 1 first and leaves them alive at 1/1. LIVE on leg (1): Tungsten Rod is a ported relic (relics/tungsten_rod.py:39) and every max-HP-loss event is reachable with it held. Leg (2) needs a max-HP loss larger than the player's max HP, which no ported event amount reaches, so leg (2) alone is dormant.
